title: Analysis-unit dependence and effect-aware calibration in human kidney thick ascending limb single-cell studies
description: Analysis code, curated derived tables, manuscript and figures for donor pseudobulk, Milo neighborhood, neighborhood-expression association, within-donor cell-rank, donor-stratified TAL signature transfer, NephQTL2 kidney eQTL context, GSE211785 snATAC context, composition-expression decomposition, independent non-KPMP single-cell validation, a prespecified 400-gene analysis-unit sensitivity panel, a reusable unitaware Python package, effect-aware conditional-null calibration, and an independent GSE175759 primary kidney-disease clinical-association analysis with TAL-content adjustment and 10,000 expression-matched random gene sets.
